title: AP/AR OFF hides the sensitive customer fields on both the Edit Customer window and the customer overview
preconds: 1. A user has a role with View and Manage AP/AR Data OFF and Customers View and Create & Edit.
steps:
1. Open a customer's Edit Customer window.
  2. Open the customer detail page's overview panel.
expected:
With AP/AR off, the sensitive customer fields (Credit terms, Credit limit, Default Labor rate, Default Shop Supplies, Min and Max, Taxes, PO is required) are hidden on the Edit Customer window.

They should also be hidden on the customer overview panel — confirm this live (a prior run flagged the overview panel as needing a re-check).
